summary: First Mining Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K reporting that its joint-venture partner, Bellavista Resources, closed the acquisition of FireFly Metals' interest in PC Gold Inc. Bellavista also exercised a buy-down right, paying C$3M to reduce First Mining's ownership in PC Gold from 30% to 20%, free-carried to a decision to mine. No price per share or premium is stated. This is a passive ownership reduction, not an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review by the registrant. The filing updates project progress; it does not trigger a special-situation category.
